title: Live review: build the market-driven due events the design names but nothing evaluates (swing, vol_regime, funding, calendar, mechanics), and push them instead of waiting for the hourly poll
note:
[2026-10-26 ~10:20Z manager session_01HAysMLfF9dYpi92YMqYxEq] Operator asked: 'are there ltr triggers other than the hourly check? E.g. big price swings or momentum shifts?'

MEASURED on main (config/live_trade_review.yaml + src/runtime/live_review_due.py):
- Evaluated events: r_milestone (every 1R), new_peak (+0.5R), giveback (>= max(0.5R, 30% of peak) after a 1R peak), near_target (<= 0.5R to TP), daily_floor (24h, real-money and prop).
- Declared but NOT evaluated (due.not_evaluated): swing, vol_regime, funding, calendar, mechanics.
- All events are POLLED: they are only computed when the hourly routine (:07) runs live_review_due. A giveback 2 min after :07 waits ~58 min. Nothing owned this gap: LTR-1-DUE-WATCH is done and only reported the unbuilt events.

SCOPE:
(1) Evaluate swing (an N x ATR move in M bars against the position), vol_regime (realised-vol / regime-head state change), funding (perp funding flip / extreme), calendar (scheduled macro events inside the hold), and mechanics (venue/package mismatch, already detected by reviewers ad hoc). Thresholds are registered in config/live_trade_review.yaml BEFORE first use, per design § 2.
(2) Event push: let the VM-side due computation fire the review (e.g. a system-action or session wake) when an event trips, instead of waiting for the hourly poll. Coordinate with LTR-APPLY-AUTOFLOW (d).

Read-path / observability only. No order path; an apply still goes through MD-LIVE-TIGHTEN-SL.

DONE WHEN: GET /api/diag/live_review_due on the VM lists a real package due on one of the new events, events_not_evaluated is empty (or names only what is still unbuilt), and the latency from event to review row is measured.

Roadmap L-ATM. Parent LIVE-TRADE-REVIEW-DESIGN.
